findings.message: The webhook marks the order "paid" on PAYMENT.CAPTURE.PENDING, but no funds have been credited yet (eCheck, review or receiving preferences). The goods ship, and the capture can later be denied, so the merchant is never paid.
The refund POST sends no PayPal-Request-Id header. If the response is lost and the refund route is retried, PayPal treats it as a new refund request instead of returning the original result.
